title: Ziyarat of Imam Hasan Askari
urduTitle: زیارت امام حسن عسکری علیہ السلام
intro: The individual visitation of Imam Hasan al-Askari at Samarra, before the source edition’s separate supplication after ziyarat.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Hasan Askari with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O my Master

blocks.arabic: يَا ابَا مُحَمَّدٍ ٱلْحَسَنُ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ
blocks.english: Abu-Muhammad al-Hasan the son of `Ali,
the guide and well-guided.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَلِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ اوْلِيَائِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waliyya allahi wabna awliya'ihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s intimate servant and son of Allah’s intimate servants.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ حُجَجِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi wabna hujajihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s decisive Argument and son of Allah’s decisive Arguments.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَفِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ اصْفِيَائِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya safiyya allahi wabna asfiya'ihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s elite and son of Allah’s elite ones.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَلِيفَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ خُلَفَائِهِ وَابَا خَلِيفَتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khalifata allahi wabna khulafa'ihi wa aba khalifatihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s representative, son of Allah’s representatives, and father of His representative.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ خَاتَمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Seal of the Prophets.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدِ ٱلْوَصِيِّينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the chief of the Prophets’ successors.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ سَيِّدَةِ نِسَاءِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the doyenne of all women of the world.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ ٱلائِمَّةِ ٱلْهَادِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the guiding leaders.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ ٱلاوْصِيَاءِ ٱلرَّاشِدِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the orthodox successors (of the Prophets.)
Peace be upon you, O shelter of the pious ones.
Peace be upon you, O leader of the winning party.
Peace be upon you, O haven of the (true) believers.
Peace be upon you, O relief of the aggrieved ones.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا وَارِثَ ٱلانْبِيَاءِ ٱلْمُنْتَجَبِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O heir of the Prophets: the choice ones.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَازِنَ عِلْمِ وَصِيِّ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya khazina `ilmi wasiyyi rasuli allahi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O keeper of the knowledge of the successor of Allah’s Messenger.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ ايُّهَا ٱلدَّاعِي بِحُكْمِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he who invites to the judgment of Allah.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ ايُّهَا ٱلنَّاطِقُ بِكِتَابِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O he who speaks with the Book of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O prime Argument of all the arguments (of Allah.)
Peace be upon you, O guide of all nations.
Peace be upon you, O source of all bounties.
Peace be upon you, O store of knowledge.
Peace be upon you, O ark of forbearance.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ابَا ٱلإِمَامِ ٱلْمُنْتَظَرِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O father of the Awaited Imam:
whose claim is evident for the rational people,
whose recognition is fixed in the most certain things,
whom is concealed against the eyes of the oppressors,
whom is hidden from the regimes of the faithless authorities,

blocks.arabic: وَٱلْمُعيدِ رَبُّنَا بِهِ ٱلإِسْلاَمَ جَدِيداً بَعْدَ ٱلإِنْطِمَاسِ
blocks.transliteration: walmu`idi rabbana bihi al-islama jadidan ba`da al-intimasi
blocks.english: and through whom our Lord shall recover Islam over again after it will be effaced
and He shall recover the Qur'an fresh over again after it will be eradicated.

blocks.transliteration: ashhadu ya mawlaya annaka aqamta alssalata
blocks.english: O master, I bear witness that you performed the prayers,
defrayed the poor-rate,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,
called to the way of your Lord
with wisdom and goodly exhortation,
and worshipped Allah sincerely
until death came upon you.

blocks.arabic: اسْالُ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلشَّانِ ٱلَّذِي لَكُمْ عِنْدَهُ
blocks.english: I thus beseech Allah in the name of the rank that you enjoy with Him
to accept my visit to you,
receive my efforts with gratitude,
respond to my prayers through you,
and include me with the supporters of the truth,
its followers, its adherents,
its devotees, and its lovers.

blocks.transliteration: wa alssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَاهْلِ بَيْتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala sayyidina muhammadin wa ahli baytihi
blocks.english: O Allah, (please do) send blessings upon our master Muhammad and his Household
and send blessings upon al-Hasan the son of `Ali
who guides to Your religion
and calls to Your way,
who is the sign of true guidance,
the lantern of true piety,
the essence of rationality,
the resource of reason,
the raining cloud over mankind,
the cloud of wisdom,
the ocean of admonition,
the heir of the Imams,
the witness over the (Muslim) community,
the sinless, the well-mannered,
the virtuous, the favorable (by Allah),
the purified against filth,
and the one whom You have given the knowledge of the (Holy) Book in inheritance,
You have inspired with clear judgment,
You have appointed as the leading sign for those who follow the direction You have decided,
You have decided the obedience to him to be attached to the obedience to You,
and You have imposed the love for him upon all Your creatures.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا انَابَ بِحُسْنِ ٱلإِخْلاَصِ فِي تَوْحِيدِكَ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma fakama anaba bihusni al-ikhlasi fi tawhidika
blocks.english: O Allah, as he always turned to You with excellent sincerity in Your Oneness,

blocks.transliteration: wa arda man khada fi tashbihika
blocks.english: argued and defeated those who anthropomorphized You,
and defended those who faithfully believed in You;
so, O my Lord, (please) pour down on him Your blessings
due to which he joins the rank of those who behave humbly toward You
and due to which he surmounts in Paradise
to the rank of his forefather the Seal of the Prophets.

blocks.transliteration: wa ballighhu minna tahiyyatan wa salaman
blocks.english: And (please do) convey to him greetings and compliments from us,

blocks.transliteration: wa atina min ladunka fi muwalatihi
blocks.english: grant us from You, on account of our loyalty to him,
favor and benevolence
and also grant us forgiveness and gratification,
for You are most certainly the Lord of enormous favor
and huge bliss.
Peace be upon you, O saint of Allah!

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ وَخَالِصَتَهُ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi wa khalisatahu
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O argument of Allah and His choicest!
Peace be upon you, O leader of the faithful believers,
inheritor of the messengers,
and argument of the Lord of the Worlds!

blocks.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ بَيْتِكَ
blocks.english: May Allah send peace upon you and upon your Household,
the pure and immaculate!
O my master, O Abu-Muhammad,
al-Hasan, the son of `Ali!

blocks.transliteration: ana mawlan laka wa li-ali baytika
blocks.english: I am a servant of you and of your Household

blocks.transliteration: wa hadha yawmuka wa huwa yawmu alkhamisi
blocks.english: and today is your day, which is Thursday,

blocks.arabic: وَأَنَا ضَيْفُكَ فِيهِ وَمُسْتَجِيرٌ بِكَ فِيهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa ana dayfuka fihi wa mustajirun bika fihi
blocks.english: and on this day, I am your guest and in your vicinity;
so, receive me hospitably as your guest and neighbor,
[I ask you] in the name of your Household, the pure and immaculate.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام حسن عسکری علیہ السلام کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
